listings.description:
Straight from the resting place of Gedeb, Ethiopia, Felloween VI comes from the Chelbesa station, where 672 smallholder farmers grow coffee at a bone-chilling 2,173 MASL.
To perform its dark magic, whole cherries endure three excruciating days of dry fermentation before being laid out on raised beds to bake in the sun for 16 to 21 days, with daily turning as they slowly dry. The result is a rich, dessert-like cup with plenty of berry-and-cream sweetness.

listings.title: Dona Tea Library
listings.description:
This is the full Dona experience, from a women-run estate in Upper Assam to whole-leaf oolong grown at up to 1,400m in Himachal Pradesh. Every tea, herb and spice is equitably sourced and traceable to its origin, and the sourcing map shows where each one comes from. Try Amber Assam and Hojicha, or Rose is my Name and Himalayan Chamomile, and find your new daily cup.
📦 Includes: 36 sachets (2 of each of the 18 teas) + Sourcing Map
🫖 Black / Oolong: Amber Assam, Grayscale, Heartbeat, Marrakesh, Rose is my Name, Palampur Oolong
🍃 Green / White: Hojicha, Rising Green, Supertwist, Wah White…

listings.title: Olympia Holiday Blend
listings.description:
Olympia’s Holiday Blend is made for the table you set this time of year. Washed and natural lots of Caturra, Bourbon and Ethiopian heirloom, grown between 1,400 and 2,100 meters, come together in a cup that’s sweet, balanced and easy to love. Every cherry was hand picked at peak holly-red ripeness. Brew a big batch for a full house, or tuck a bag under the tree for the coffee lover on your list.
Glad tidings. Comfort. Joy.

listings.title: Olympia Decaf Holiday Blend
listings.description:
The best holiday moments happen late: the second slice of pie, the last story at the table. Olympia’s Decaf Holiday Blend is made for exactly then. Grown above 1,800 meters in Colombia, this washed Caturra and Colombia lot is decaffeinated with the sugar cane (EA) process, which uses a natural compound from fermented sugar cane to gently remove caffeine while keeping the coffee’s sweetness intact. Pour it alongside dessert, any time of day.
Glad tidings. Comfort. Joy.

listings.title: Mixology Set
listings.description: The Mixology Set is designed to make great cocktails with precision and pleasure. Stir smoothly and evenly using a carefully weighted spoon, keep a tidier bar with vessels engineered for cleaner pours, and preserve the rhythm of your ritual with a shaker lid that releases cleanly. And when the last cocktail is poured, return everything to its place, ready for the next one.

listings.title: Heartstrings
listings.description:
Always featuring coffees from Ethiopia, the birthplace of coffee, Heartstrings was created to capture all the best aspects of a fruity natural while still delivering the balance and reliability of something more traditional.
Naturally processed coffees are dried with the ripe coffee cherry left intact, developing rich, jammy fruit flavors. Wonderstate pairs this with a washed coffee roasted to a sweet, cozy depth, creating a layered medium roast that brings together fruit, richness, and balance.
Jammy plum, dried fruit, and milk chocolate.

listings.title: Rebrew Espresso Series 1
listings.description:
Series 1 is designed to feel approachable from the first shot. Clear guidance and thoughtful defaults help you get started without intimidation, while the machine’s precision removes much of the variability that makes espresso feel fragile or inconsistent.
Over time, that confidence turns into control. Series 1 gives you a stable foundation to refine recipes, repeat your best results, and explore espresso more deeply. Whether you’re learning, dialing in, or settling into a daily routine, the experience stays clear, dependable, and rewarding.
Final Sale: this item may not be returned or…

listings.title: Cardamom Cloud
listings.description:
Grown at Finca El Paraíso in Colombia, this Castillo lot showcases the Bermudez family’s signature precision and experimentation in processing.
After being harvested at peak ripeness, the cherries are ozone-washed before undergoing a 72-hour double anaerobic fermentation, submerged in water with cultures in a milk medium. Once pulped, the coffee undergoes a thermal-shock wash to lock in complexity and sweetness. It’s then dried in a dehumidifier to preserve its delicate aromatics and prevent over-oxidation.
The result is a floral, spiced cup with radiant notes of cardamom, pistachio, and…

listings.title: Necessary Dark Roast
listings.description:
Necessary Dark Roast brings together two origins that complement one another beautifully. Burundian coffee contributes deep sweetness, while Peruvian coffee adds body and persistent chocolate flavors, creating a rich, balanced blend.  Sweet enough to enjoy black and bold enough to pair beautifully with milk, it's perfect served hot or iced.  Bittersweet, cocoa, and molasses.
🌎 Origin: Burundi + Peru
⚗️ Process: Washed
🔬 Variety: Field Blend
🔥 Roast: Dark
Necessary Coffee Roasters was founded in 2019 by the team behind Passenger in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. Since day one, their philosophy…

listings.title: Juan Puerta Mango
listings.description:
Created by Resident Coffee Roasters in collaboration with Juan Puerta of Sens Coffee, this light roast begins with Castillo from La Sirena in Quindío, Colombia, before undergoing an innovative mango osmotic dehydration process that builds a bold tropical profile while preserving the coffee's natural structure.
The result is a juicy, candy-like cup with remarkable clarity. Follow the Brew Guide and brew it on Aiden to bring out every layer of its vibrant fruit character.
Fruit Rollup, Mango Lollipop, Jumex Mango Nectar.
🌎 Origin: Colombia
⚗️ Process: Osmotic dehydration
🔬 Variety:…

listings.title: Moonrise
listings.description: Moonrise is crafted to showcase the harmony that comes from blending washed and naturally processed coffees. It yields a syrupy, full-bodied cup with layered sweetness and ripe fruit character, offering both depth and balance. Equally rewarding as espresso or a pourover, Moonrise delivers brightness and lingering sweetness in every cup.

listings.title: Big Joy
listings.description: Big Joy is a slightly more developed roast than Moonrise, and pairs exceptionally well with milk. We use it for all milk-based drinks in our café, where it brings richness and balance, and it brews a dynamic, layered solo shot as well. Don’t count it out as a filter option, Big Joy is equally delicious and sweet brewed on your favorite device.

listings.title: Struttura
listings.description: Struttura is a blend focused on texture. The shots are dense and syrupy, with flavors that are sweet, weighty, and dimensional. Seasonally-selected coffees produce sweet tones of dark chocolate, red fruits, and molasses, with a full, honey-like body. Struttura is easy to dial in and excellent for espresso, but it also brews a vibrant and balanced cup of drip.

listings.title: Haro Wachu Filter
listings.description:
The coffee comes from Ethiopia's Guji Zone, where smallholder families grow heirloom trees above 2,250 meters. The warm days and cold nights ripen the cherries slowly, building sugars and concentration for a light, refreshing cup that’s the perfect start to any morning.
Notes: white floral, mandarin orange, black tea.
🌎 Origin: Guji, Ethiopia
⚗️ Process: Washed
🔬 Variety: Heirloom
🔥 Roast: Light

listings.title: Haro Wachu Espresso
listings.description:
Surprisingly complex and expressive for an everyday shot, it finishes chocolateycaramel-sweet and holds up wonderfully in milk. It comes from BlendIn Coffee Club, a Houston roaster specializing in single-origin, direct-trade coffees with full traceability.
Notes: orange marmalade, milk chocolate, toffee.
🌎 Origin: Guji, Ethiopia
⚗️ Process: Washed
🔬 Variety: Heirloom
🔥 Roast: Medium

listings.title: The Series 1 + Grinder Kit
listings.description:
Fresh grinding is the quiet foundation of great espresso. By pairing Opus 2 with Series 1, each shot begins with coffee ground precisely for the recipe you’re brewing.
That freshness allows Series 1 to do what it does best: guide when you want support, step back when you don’t, and deliver repeatable results without feeling rigid. The process feels calmer, more intuitive, and far less intimidating.
Kits and bundles cannot be combined with other discount codes.

listings.title: Opus 2 + Espresso Accessories Kit
listings.description:
Great espresso comes from consistency across every step. Opus 2 gives you the precision and control to dial in your grind for espresso, helping you pull shots with better balance, texture, and clarity.
The accessories handle the rest. A magnetic dosing funnel reduces mess, while a WDT tool improves distribution for more even extraction. A tamping mat stabilizes your setup for consistent pressure, and a knock box streamlines cleanup. An electric vacuum canister preserves the freshness of your coffee beans so every shot starts with better flavor.
Kits and bundles cannot be combined with other…

listings.title: Jaguar Espresso
listings.description: Our Sun Dried Natural selection comes from Kayon Mountain Estate located in Southern Guji, Ethiopia. Coffee cherries are left to dry whole with the fruit encasing the seed, or "bean", to impart flavor. The result is a cup layered with ripe, berry-like fruit tones.

listings.title: Ethiopia Sun Dried Natural
listings.description: Our Sun Dried Natural selection comes from Kayon Mountain Estate located in Southern Guji, Ethiopia. In the natural process, coffee cherries are left to dry whole with the fruit encasing the bean to impart flavor. The result is a cup layered with ripe, berry-like fruit tones.

listings.title: Robinson Salamanca
listings.description:
A Drops-exclusive Pink Bourbon from San Isidro farm in San Agustín, Colombia. Harvested over just a few days and roasted light by ilse coffee.
This lot from Robinson Salamanca's farm was harvested and processed exclusively for Fellow Drops. It’s roasted by ilse coffee, known for high-end micro lots with an emphasis on flavor clarity and full traceability, and for working primarily with smallholder producers.
This lot comes through Monkaaba, a producer-led collective in San Agustín built to give farmers like Robinson the market access, knowledge, and support they deserve. Fruit-forward and…

listings.title: Olgar Ortega
listings.description:
A rich, full-bodied Caturra from Villa Maria farm in San Agustín, Colombia, processed with meticulous attention at every step and roasted medium-light by ilse coffee.
The Ortega-Gomez family has been growing coffee in San Agustín for over sixty years. The family also helped to found Monkaaba, a producer-led collective built to give smallholder farmers in the region the market access, knowledge, and support.
This lot is a separation of Caturra harvested in August 2025. Cherries are picked at peak ripeness every three weeks, floated, then fermented in open tanks before being depulped,…

listings.title: Decaf Monkaaba
listings.description:
A light decaf Colombia sourced from producer-led collective Monkaaba and roasted by ilse in North Canaan, CT.
Founders Rebecca and Lucas say the Decaf Monkaaba is one of the best decafs they’ve ever tried. A blend of coffees from key producers in the Monkaaba producer network, it’s sweet with a pillowy mouthfeel and great balance. Citrus, brown sugar, wafer cookie.
🌎 Origin: San Agustín, Colombia
⚗️ Process: Sugarcane Washed
🔥 Roast: Light
About the roaster:
ilse has been roasting in North Canaan, Connecticut since 2019, founded to showcase the world's best coffees and open people's eyes to…

listings.title: Twisted V.9 Espresso
listings.description:
Named after the way espresso “twists” as it streams from the spout of a portafilter, this medium-light blend is crafted to marry the chocolate and caramel notes of a classic espresso roast with the bright fruit notes of newer wave espressos.
🌎 Origin: South + Central America and Africa
🔬 Variety: Various
🔥 Roast: Medium-Light
📝Brew Guide: https://drop.fyi/l1v4

listings.title: Panama Elida Estate Catuai Reserva Natural ASD
listings.description:
Founded in 1918, Lamastus Family Estates includes Elida Estate, a farm shaped by cool cloud-forest conditions and distinctive microclimates along the edge of Volcán Barú National Park. Coffee here ripens slowly in the mist, building density and layered flavor as it matures.
For this lot, ripe cherries are picked at peak sweetness and processed using Wilford Lamastus’s Anaerobic Slow Dry method. The whole cherries ferment in a sealed tank for five days, then move to raised beds for an extended, low-and-slow dry of roughly 45 to 60 days. That longer drying time helps deepen complexity and…

listings.title: Peru Umapata Community
listings.description:
A medium roast washed coffee from the Umapata community in Cusco, Peru sourced in partnership with the award-winning Yungas Coffee Project and roasted by Sacramento’s Camellia Coffee Roasters.
Bright & sweet, this crowd pleaser embodies Camellia’s mantra to create “coffees with character.”  Pull it as espresso to get caramelized sugar and mandarin jam, brew it as drip for cara cara zest and toffee.  With hot summer days ahead, it also makes an exceptional cold brew.
This coffee is connected to the Yungas Coffee Project, winner of the Sprudgie Award for Outstanding Achievement. This farmer-led…

listings.title: Monarch
listings.description:
Monarch is our most developed roast that conveys a flavor profile that we intentionally designed to work well with milk. Cream and plant based beverages mix with ease, creating a rich, decadent flavor. It involves a natural, sugar-dense coffee that binds to the fats and creates multiple complex caramelized notes during the roasting process. Look for dark chocolate and undertones of thick winey berries. Enjoy as drip or espresso.
Fulfilled by Onyx Coffee Lab

listings.title: Costa Rica, La Guaca
listings.description:
Setting aside conventional labels like light or dark, Methodical roasts each coffee to express the life it lived, including the weather, the soil, and the place it grew. This floral and tropical Red Catuai from La Guaca is a perfect example of that philosophy.
La Guaca was honey-processed by Régulo Ureña and Isabel Rojas at their world-renowned family-run micro-mill in the Chirripó region. Honey processing is a specialty in the region, striking a measured balance that we love– more mellow than a straight-up natural but incredibly flavorful.  La Guaca is named after nearby indigenous…

listings.title: Cherry Pick
listings.description:
Cherry Pick comes from Ratnagiri Estate in the Bababudangiri region, family-owned by the Patre family since 1927. Third-generation grower Ashok Patre shade-grows the cherries alongside pepper and cardamom at 1,200 meters. The cherries go through a meticulous anaerobic natural fermentation in stainless steel tanks, locking in the stone-fruit sweetness and syrupy body that defines this lot.
🌎 Origin: Ratnagiri Estate, Western Ghats, India
⚗️ Process: Anaerobic Natural
🔬 Variety: S795 / Chandragiri
🔥 Roast: Medium-Light

listings.title: Andres Martinez, Blackberry Co-Ferment
listings.description:
This week’s Drop is Andrés Martinez, a special, limited release Blackberry co-ferment from one of Colombia's most innovative producers.
Andrés Martinez is a producer whose creativity shines in the processing method—a four-day anaerobic fermentation with castilla blackberries and enology yeast, followed by an open fermentation in blackberry juice.
Roasted by Mom 'n 'em in  Cincinnati, the result is bright, eccentric, and expressive, with taste notes of macerated berry, black tea, and demerara.
🌎 Origin: Cauca, Colombia
⚗️ Process: Honey / Blackberry Co-Ferment
🔬 Variety: Caturra
🔥 Roast:…

listings.title: Lucia’s Guatemala
listings.description:
This week’s Drop is Lucia's Guatemala, a single-origin coffee from DOMA Coffee Roasting Company in Post Falls, ID.
The team at DOMA has spent almost 10 years working with K-Finos in Guatemala and this accessible dark roast reflects that long relationship.
During their travels to the farm, the team cups the fresh crop to find the ideal match for this profile—full-bodied with a mild acidity and light, sugary sweetness. A subtle brightness unfolds with notes of warming spices, cocoa and dried fruit.
🌎 Origin: Guatemala
⚗️ Process: Washed
🔬 Variety: Bourbon, Catuai, Caturra, Pache, and San…

When Series 1 is supported by the right tools, its strengths show up even more clearly. The machine’s guidance, control, and consistency are easier to access when the surrounding workflow stays organized and uninterrupted.
With every essential piece in place except a grinder, Series 1 becomes easier to enjoy day after day. The result is not just great espresso, but a more confident experience every time you step up to the machine.

listings.title: Ethiopia Anasora Guji Natural
listings.description:
This natural coffee from the Anasora district in Guji is a semi-forest coffee, which has been grown underneath indigenous shade trees intercropped with spices, tuber crops and false banana.
The Guji region’s unique terroir along with the farmers’ passion and acute attention to detail result in a punchy cup presenting raspberry, stone fruit and golden raisin flavors with a bright champagne acidity.
🌎 Origin: South Guji Zone, Ethiopia
⚗️ Process: Natural
🔬 Variety: Heriloom
🔥 Roast: Light

listings.title: Los Pinos Bourbon
listings.description:
Los Pinos, ‘the pines,’ takes its name from the forest canopies of Chiapas. This Bourbon is grown in the communities of Ángel Albino Corzo, where native pine trees provide shade and cooler air that slows the maturation of the cherry, building natural density and depth.
Producers hand-pick ripe cherries only, fermenting them in open tanks for 48 hours before a meticulous wash and slow dry. The result is a cup with clarity rarely seen in Mexican coffees, with notes of caramel, honey and a soft citrus finish.
Developed on a Loring roaster with Espresso Series 1 in mind, where body and sweetness…

listings.title: 8oz Storage Jar – Blue Lid
listings.description: Protect what you need to by storing in Nalgene leak-proof, air-tight storage containers. Stackable for convenient storage. The wide mouth opening makes it easy to scoop what you need when you need it. Shatter resistant and dishwasher safe. Shop our full range of storage .

reviews.author: Andy
reviews.body: What are the diameters of the lid sizes. Also, what is the height for each size. Trying to see if they will fit in my cooler.

listings.title: 32oz/24oz Epic Filter Cap + Kit
listings.description: Epic Easy Sip Lid, Straw and Everywhere Filter for Nalgene 32 and 24 oz Wide Mouth bottles.

reviews.author: Daniel G
reviews.body: Filters water well, but the cap leaks when just slightly tipped. Destroyed a few books and could have damaged my laptop. Reached out for a warranty replacement and was denied. Okay, lost $250 worth of books and couldn’t even get a replacement cap? Like the cap itself couldn’t be more than $5 for them to produce and I’d have left a good review after verifying that it didn’t leak. Come on

reviews.author: Emily
reviews.body: Love this water filter, have been using a Brita, but that bottle cap breaks very easily. This was great because I had a couple Nalgenes lying around from my kids so I just got this kit and tried it out on an OTF. The filter is just slightly harder to pull water through, but not difficult. I use this at work and can fill up anywhere I go!. This design is much sturdier, and I am happy that is Nalgene is made in the USA. Will be purchasing more!

reviews.author: Shawn
reviews.body: This is extremely hard to suck water through. I only used this for tap water at my work location. I can't imagine using this in the mountains. You would suck your eyeballs out trying to get water through it!

listings.title: 12oz Kids Grip-N-Gulp Sustain Water Bottle
listings.sourceType: By Shape, By Size, Kids Water Bottles, Today's Sales
listings.description: This Made in USA spill-proof sippy cup is made to withstand every adventure. A rubberized lid and smooth mouthpiece ensure comfortable and safe sipping. Tested by toddlers, beloved by parents.

listings.title: 32oz Wide Mouth “Happy Gene” Bottle
listings.sourceType: By Shape, By Size, Everyday, Water Bottles
listings.description: The Classic Nalgene featuring the graphic “Happy Gene” in Chinese characters.

reviews.author: Y.B.
reviews.body:
If you are hesitant about buying this then let me give you two easy solutions:
-Buy stickers to put on this bottle
-Or buy a sleeve and slip it into the bottle
I've done both and it's that easy! I love this bottle a lot!

reviews.author: Jude
reviews.body: Absolute banger of a water bottle! Love the color combo and the “happy gene” is just the perfect side kick to the “Nalgene” brand. This bottle will make your genes happy and make your life better! BUY IT!! I’ve bought 6 of these and have gifted them out!

listings.title: Nal The Nalgene Sticker
listings.description: This sticker is dishwasher safe, UV coated, and perfect for decorating your Nalgene bottle. Made in the USA – just like us.

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.body: Good quality, nice design

listings.title: 16oz Narrow Mouth Fruit Print Bottles
listings.sourceType: By Shape, By Size, Collections, Featured, Kids Water Bottles, Water Bottles
listings.description: The classic BPA/BPS-free Nalgene Narrow Mouth bottle in 3 delightful fruit prints. Proudly made in the USA from Tritan Renew.

reviews.author: Phoebe
reviews.body: Great quality bottle (as always), but sadly the graphics don't hold up to dishwasher and fairly regular use. I've got 16-yr-old bottles with Nalgene logos still intact, but my logo and lemons are 50% gone after a year. :(

reviews.author: Mehmet Efran
reviews.body: I was pay so many for it but it's 7 number of plastic. What will I do now? It's very good plastic but it's not suitable for my healt. I'm in Turkiye but that's made in USA. Again again again, what will I do now?

reviews.author: Belen
reviews.body: I wish this was in 32 oz water bottle because it is so darn cute i love it and want so much but it would be way to small for me and i re-fill the 32 oz at least 3 times a day so imagine a 16 oz

listings.title: 12oz Kids On-The-Fly Lock-Top Bottle
listings.sourceType: By Shape, By Size, Collections, Kids Water Bottles, Water Bottles
listings.description: Controlled sipping for little water-drinkers with a lock-top that makes it leak-proof and spill-proof.

reviews.author: Jim STL
reviews.body: Perfect variety if sizes, totally spill proof, great colors, we use for school, lunches, sports practices, and daily lunch boxes. So easy to open, fill, clean. Great variety of bottle colors, patterns, and lid colors, so kiddos can mix/match and personalize. And indestructible, too! Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Kim
reviews.body:
I like the concept of these, but in practice they turned out to be a bad choice for our kids. You have to push pretty hard to latch the lid - harder than my 4 & 2 year old can push. So instead, they frequently end up tipping the bottle over and spilling it. Or it looks like it's latched, but when it later inevitably gets tipped or picked up by the loop, it spills then.
The lock is also too stiff for the kids to put on by themselves.
I got the same top for me and it's fine for an adult bottle, but it's not great for kids.
Also, these bottles seem to sweat more than other water bottles, leaving condensation on whatever is next to them (particularly a problem because I want to be able to throw them in a backpack without worrying about it).

listings.title: 12oz On-The-Fly Kids Lock-Top Bottle with Graphics
listings.sourceType: By Shape, By Size, Featured, Kids Water Bottles, Water Bottles
listings.description: Sipping made easy with this lock-top bottle for little hands. Pop the top to drink from the spout. Lock it closed for leak-proof storage.

reviews.author: marcello m
reviews.body:
These are a great size, but are not fully EDC (endocrine disrupting chemical) free, I've been researching the entire market of water bottle production, and these nalgene (make sure it's the new batch numbers, the older ones contain several main EDCs, just not BPA) are the "safest" plastic ones out there.
The biggest issue is they take A HUGE amount of strength to close, I'm a decently strong adult, and I need to use both hands and my chest muscles to close them, and the little plastic catch on both my bottles are already cracked from the force.
These may be conveniently sized, and aesthetically designed for kids, but are not kid friendly.

listings.title: 12oz Kids Grip-N-Gulp with Graphics
listings.sourceType: By Shape, By Size, Kids Water Bottles, Today's Sales
listings.description: This Made in USA spill-proof sippy cup is made to withstand every adventure. A rubberized lid and smooth mouthpiece ensure comfortable and safe sipping, and bottle comes with a protective cover. Tested by toddlers, beloved by parents.

reviews.author: Irene
reviews.body: These are my kids absolute favorites! I love them too since they are so easy to clean and simple to put together. But my favorite part is that they never leak (unless it's dropped enough that the rubber part dislodges) with temperature changes coming out of the fridge. Would love to buy replacement tops as they look a bit chewed on after a while. Ps yay made in USA!

reviews.author: Joseph Aguirre
reviews.body: These "Gulp" lids have no flow. There's no way for air to get in, so nothing comes out. A water bottle that you can't actually get any water out of is useless.

reviews.author: Devin
reviews.body: Nice, but why cant we buy replacement lids (not just the valves)?

reviews.author: Zahid Raza
reviews.body: its nice

listings.title: 48oz Wide Mouth Silo Bottle
listings.description: More volume for more adventures. 48oz of BPA/BPA-free Tritan Renew.

reviews.author: Jared
reviews.body: Does not glow, at all. Even when holding a light to the bottle, it returns to this color immediately after. Very disappointed.

reviews.author: Jared
reviews.body: Buyer beware with the glow in the dark bottle…it doesn’t. Even when “charging” with a light, it returns to the normal color instantly. No glowing

reviews.author: Andrew
reviews.body: I carried one of these for twenty plus years and it only died due to falling just right on some rocks. Will always carry one of these for my water

reviews.author: Jose Navarro
reviews.body: Its very sturdy and I enjoyed carrying it around until it developed a chemical smell. I’m concerned the plastic might cause me health problems. I’ve owned it for over a year and its only hand washed.

reviews.author: Calvin Motes
reviews.body: Love it, just wish they'd do some of the darker colors in this size, like the dark purple or the jade.

listings.title: 24oz On-The-Fly Lock-Top Bottle
listings.sourceType: Everyday, Fitness, Kids Water Bottles, Water Bottles
listings.description: Lock-top. Pop-top. One-handed sipping On-The-Fly.

reviews.author: Mona
reviews.body: This water bottle works immensely well. I’ve been using it regularly for four to five years now and it still works. No leaks, no dents. The “Nalgene” logo washed off with time, but I’m comfortable with that. I highly, highly recommend this water bottle. I hope you have a lovely day!!!

reviews.author: hwash
reviews.body: I have had a number of these over the years. I really like the design but minus one star because they have still not figured out a way to stop the silicone plug that seals the mouth from getting gross. Over time, mould starts growing in the little space inside the plug, and you have to pry it out and sanitize it periodically. I think the plug should be glued in place at the factory so mould can't get in in the first place.

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.body: Perfect size and easy to take anywhere. But, like everyone else is saying, please make it possible to replace the rubber stopper because it gets so gross over time and I would prefer not to replace the entire cap!

reviews.author: Jeanne Regh
reviews.body: These water bottles are great, but they have one big flaw, which is the silicone stopper that fits inside the top. It is not sold separately, you must buy the entire top to get one. They mold no matter where you live, FL or CO - humid or dry climates. They mold no matter whether you wash them every day, put them in the dishwasher, soak them, etc... The bottle is great, but MOLD not so much.

reviews.author: Audrey
reviews.body: Nalgene classic- made to last. Nalgene on the fly? Made to break. I like the idea (I wanted a straw-free, low-fuss mechanism for a water bottle- this fit the bill perfectly) but within 1 day of use, the locking mechanism broke, and the lid wouldn't stay shut unless the metal clip was fastened...my daughter dropped it, and the metal clip unlatched and the lid flew open......water everywhere.

listings.title: 32oz Narrow Mouth Bottle
listings.description: The classic BPA/BPS- free Nalgene Narrow Mouth bottle is now thoughtfully made from Tritan Renew.

reviews.author: Patrick McMullin
reviews.body: Surfs up dudes,and lassie's!{It is another great time in Florida,and this water bottle is most excellent!{The Nalgene 32 oz. Water bottle is groovy!I just gotta take it out of the freezer!}

reviews.author: Samuel Muraski
reviews.body:
I’m a forest engineer and spend almost every day pioneering rugged mountain terrain. Almost 2 years of using this bottle on every adventure it finally broke after being dropped for the millionth time.
I know it’s weird to find a 5-star review about a product breaking, but this water bottle has been my trusty companion on every occasion and it’s durability was pushed far beyond any reasonable expectations. I would recommend it to anyone. I’m gonna try an ultra lite this time around. I have a few other bottle made of the ultra lite material and their flexibility may be better equipped for my abuse.

reviews.author: Daniel
reviews.body: Love mine, had it for almost 20 years. Please make a 48 oz narrow mouth for hiking!

reviews.author: Neil Sowinski
reviews.body: I have had the dark red 32oz with black cap since 2002. It is all original and has survived the freezer 3 times. I estimate I have had close to 1000 gallons of water thru it. I'd say it's a great product.

reviews.author: Jason Gaze
reviews.body: Love the wide mouth 32oz bottles. I have several. Just bought the narrow mouth bottle. Same great water bottle but easier to drink from? Gotta have it! They’re the only water bottles for me.

listings.title: 16oz Narrow Mouth Bottle
listings.sourceType: By Shape, By Size, Everyday, Kids Water Bottles, Outdoors, Water Bottles
listings.description: The classic BPA/BPS- free Nalgene Narrow Mouth bottle is now thoughtfully made from Tritan Renew.

reviews.author: Natasha Baker
reviews.body: Great quality plastic and colors are displayed accurately on the pictures. I got a 16oz and 32oz bottle in the color Mocha. They’re beautiful!

listings.title: 16oz Wide Mouth Bottle
listings.sourceType: Everyday, Kids Water Bottles, Outdoors, Water Bottles
listings.description: The classic BPA/BPS- free Nalgene Wide Mouth bottle is now thoughtfully made from Tritan Renew.

reviews.author: John Casteel
reviews.body:
16 oz is my favorite size for a travel bottle but another vote to develop a splash guard for the 16 oz wide mouth. Love your products. Just ordered some small travel bottles to replace a very old set of Nalgene travel bottles.
Would be 5 stars but for the lack of this needed accessory. That 5th star is the carrot to get busy.
Oh well, made if 5 stars anyway because I like your products too much to deprive you.
PS. make a guard for splashes for the 16oz. :)

reviews.author: John Casteel
reviews.body:
16 oz is my favorite size for a travel bottle but another vote to develop a splash guard for the 16 oz wide mouth. Love your products. Just ordered some small travel bottles to replace a very old set of Nalgene travel bottles.
Would be 5 stars but for the lack of a splash guard. That 5th star is the carrot to get busy.
Oh well, made if 5 stars anyway because I like your products too much to deprive you.
PS. make a splash guard for the 16oz. :)

reviews.author: Amy L.
reviews.body: The 16-oz Nalgene wide mouth bottle is a must in my carry-on bag when I travel, especially water refilling stations are becoming more common in airports nowadays. It’s more compact than the narrow mouth version, and thus is easier to pack. If the hotel I am staying in also has water refilling stations, then I’ll either bring a second 16-oz bottle or a 32-oz bottle, depending on the purpose of the trip and how much space I have in my suitcase. The BPA or even the BPA-free debates have left me mostly confused. So I use stainless steel bottles whenever possible. But when I have to optimize weight and space, I turn to my Nalgene bottles.

reviews.author: Jami
reviews.body:
I like the size of the bottle for the kids, but find it odd that it isn't a traditional wide mouth size. I got it with the intention of kids backpacking and being able to attach the water filter to it, but since it is not a standard wide mouth it won't fit. We also can't swap cap types or find splash guards for them. We have one of the 12oz kids bottles and that is a standard wide mouth, so not sure why 16oz is an odd ball mouth size.
Aside from that, standard Nalgene quality and we are happy with it.

reviews.author: legs
reviews.body: Ordered the green 16 oz wide mouth and the quality is really sad. Definitely not the Nalgene I remember. The lid strap is too tight for the cap to freely turn and there are sloppy little bits of untrimmed, peeling plastic all over it. Pretty disappointed.

listings.title: 16oz Wide Mouth Cap
listings.description: Fits the 16oz Nalgene Wide Mouth bottles.

listings.title: 32oz Wide Mouth Bottle
listings.description: The classic BPA/BPS- free Nalgene Wide Mouth bottle is now thoughtfully made from Tritan Renew.

reviews.author: Douglas
reviews.body: I have used my glow in the dark 1 liter bottle everyday for more than 10 years. While it's a bit scuffed, it's still glows nicely when I search for it at night. I'm not much of a consumer, I will use this bottle until it is absolutely destroyed, but when it is I will buy another one.

reviews.author: Dillan
reviews.body: I have the 24oz and 32oz wide-mouth bottles, with the sleeves. I love all the Nalgene bottles I've had, they are super high-quality, and I like the wide-mouth because they are very easy to clean.

reviews.author: The Rizzler
reviews.body:
After using for several weeks, it's official. I give the Nalgene water bottle FIVE BIG BOOMS!! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Thank you.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.body: I have 3, 32oz wide mouth Nalgene Bottles. My favorite was always a deep orange with a silky silver/white top. I carried this bottle everywhere, everyday and still do most days on a rotation. The reason this water bottle is my favorite is... about a decade ago, I was jumping out of a plane with this water bottle (about half full of water) in a special carrying pouch on my equipment. At some point after exiting the aircraft, the fastener on the pouch failed and my Nalgene flew out and plummeted 850(ish) to the ground which was a mix of sand and clay. I looked for few minutes before finding my bottle forcefully nested into the sand. I examined the bottle and there were no cracks! It was a bit scuffed from the landing, but fully functional! I bought two others shortly after and have never…

reviews.author: Aniyra Chan
reviews.body:
I adored this bottle, but it barely lasted a month.
Dropped it onto a hard surface but from a very small height, no higher than 3ft, and it has a huge crack in it. Sadly no longer useable.

listings.title: 32oz On-The-Fly Water Bottle
listings.sourceType: By Shape, By Size, Everyday, Fitness, Outdoors, Water Bottles
listings.description: The Original 32 oz Wide Mouth Nalgene with our  On-The-Fly top. This leak proof, lock-top opens easily for convenient one-hand refreshment on the fly. Ideal for care-free storage in work bags, gym bags, backpacks and cup holders.

reviews.author: N
reviews.body:
This is truly the best bottle to tote around to the office and on hikes. The slimmer 24 oz bottle is great for fitting into cup holders but I drink a lot of water, especially in the summer and it's worth carrying a bigger purse or bag to accommodate the 32oz. Once there are more colors I will buy another one.
Minus 1/2 star because I've had 4 ONF 24oz bottles for years and the cap will eventually end up moldy despite efforts to keep it dry. I don't live in a humid area either. Also minus 1/2 one star because with OTF caps you never know if you're going to get a normal clicking cap or one that requires a firmer click and the clasp requires a firmer push too. It would be perfect for people with hand issues if the caps all clicked consistently and the clasp clicked consistently as well. This…

reviews.author: David Freese
reviews.body: I have several of the 20 and 24 oz. bottles like this and have never had a problem. Backpacking, riding my bike and using one handed. Even bought one of the "kiddy" 12 oz. for an extra.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.body: Much better than the screw-on top of the everyday bottles! I wish the 32oz bottles with that top came in more colors. I have used two bottles with the pop tops for years now and they have never ever created any issue.

reviews.author: Jim Johnson
reviews.body: These are great tops! Don't leak, are secure and well designed. We buy a lot of these and everyone loves them.

reviews.author: Filnbirt
reviews.body: Used the pop top for years, and it has never spilled of failed for me yet. When I lost my original one I had to purchase a new one right away as it's so handy.

listings.title: 12oz On-The-Fly Kids Lock-Top Bottle with Graphics
listings.sourceType: Kids Water Bottles, Today's Sales, Water Bottles
listings.description: Sipping made easy with this lock-top bottle for little hands. Pop the top to drink from the spout. Lock it closed for leak-proof storage.

reviews.author: Jola
reviews.body: great bottles for kids. I never had a better one. Not only BPA free but also not leaking, safe closing preventing opening by accident, nice colours and design.

listings.title: 32oz Narrow Mouth Oasis Bottle
listings.sourceType: By Shape, By Size, Water Bottles
listings.description: Tenacity meets capacity a modern take on the classic camping canteen.

reviews.author: Rob
reviews.body:
It’s no frills, low weight, and long lasting. I’ve cycled through all the plastic bottles but have always had an embarrassing affinity for canteens from being in the military. They just fit the hand so well, fit in any pocket, and somehow always feel like they take up less space than all the other 1L bottles out there.
The bonus points for this one over other canteens:
- you can actually see the quantity and quality of the water you’ve got
-it’s got a textured surface and is surprisingly robust for how lightweight it is
-it fits exactly 1 liter of water at the top, so slightly more than a surplus canteen
-the water never has that “canteen” taste or smell to it no matter how long it sits in there
-you don’t look like a cringey boot rocking a green canteen
-if it’s your kind of thing, it…

reviews.author: Jayde
reviews.body: The best Nalgene bottle out there! does not roll off the cliff when knocked over. Needs new colors and the line needs to be expanded. I would like to see one that glows in the dark!

reviews.author: Jay
reviews.body:
Too expensive at $16. They used to be like $8 a year ago. First they disappeared for 2 years, they said it was supply chain issues. Now they restock them at twice the price. Sounds like a little market manipulation....sad.
Anyway, for slightly over what they a charging now you could get a pretty nice brand name stainless steel bottle.

reviews.author: Tim
reviews.body: Too expensive for what it is.

reviews.author: Bradley Zmuda
reviews.body: This is the best Nalgene product hands down. Same great narrow mouth for ease of drinking and pouring, no seals to go bad, wide shape is easier to hold, won’t roll if it tips over unlike the round designs, matte texture so it doesn’t look grimy over time, fits into bags better, and extremely durable courtesy of Tritan construction. And all for a reasonable price made in the USA? Basically a perfect waterbottle! Only thing it could potentially use is some graduated markings on the side but that would detract from the minimalist aesthetic.

listings.title: Wide Mouth Easy Sipper
listings.description: Snaps into your Wide Mouth Loop-Top bottles to control spills and splashes. Fits 32oz & 48oz Wide Mouth only.

reviews.author: Linda
reviews.body: I like Nalgene measurements..and it's a decent water bottle although I hate when people feel it's possible to keep mine as a gift when actually it's theft

reviews.author: Ranee
reviews.body: @nalgene with the sipper on can you still use the screw lid with it

reviews.author: kb
reviews.body: It's still very easy for water to spill all over if drinking quickly or while moving. I think Splash Guards are MUCH more effective.

reviews.author: Jade
reviews.body: I don't use my Nalgene without this! SO much easier to drink out of without spilling. Stays put. Great invention!

reviews.author: Susan
reviews.body: I was dubious about the efficacy of this product but boy was I wrong. I use the blue one on my ultralight I love that its a perfect color match, but more importantly it works exactly as intended: easy to put in correctly, stays on during use, and easy to pop out. 100/10 would recommend

listings.title: Wide Mouth Cap
listings.description: Fits 32 & 48oz Wide Mouth Bottles.

reviews.author: Erin
reviews.body: I bought this as a replacement because my old cap broke where the hinge attaches. The new one only lasted me a yea Rand I only use it when I got hiking. I never attach it to my bag, I put it in a pouch. Occasionally I carry it by the hinge. I’m super disappointed. I thought these were meant to survive rugged outdoors adventures.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.body: My lid leash tore and the bottle/ color combo is discontinued ( brown bottle with orange leash). Black lid replacement looks weird and is already tearing after a few months.

reviews.author: Brett
reviews.body: The cap leashes are very disappointing compared to past generations. It's the first week of March and one I got brand new with a bottle at Christmas is already torn through- and it was never under heavy stress- the texture of the cap ribbing essentially sawed through it like a serated blade. In fact, I only used it a third of the time because I cycle through three different bottles.

reviews.author: Elvia D
reviews.body:
I see a lot people complaining that the straps don't last as long as they used to. That hasn't been my experience. My lid straps only ever ripped after my cats chewed on them, they seem to be obsessed with these!
Otherwise all straps and lids have all lasted me as long as the bottles so far. I hand wash only, take them hiking and do not hang them by the strap on my bag, but do occasionally hold them by the straps. Never had one rip with normal use. I like to periodically replace my lids only because I like the variety of color, and again, my cats LOVE to chew on them.
Very happy with this product!!

reviews.author: Austen Reiter
reviews.body: Ordered the color Pink and it is a different (darker) shade than what is depicted on the website.

listings.title: OTF Cap
listings.description: Fits 12, 24, & 32oz Wide Mouth Bottles.

reviews.author: Steve Cohen
reviews.body:
Easy to drink from with a wide mouth bottle, snap works well.
But the silicone seal gets moldy.
***Please sell the seal as a spare part!!!***

reviews.author: Fred
reviews.body: My wife's bottle is in great condition for being as old as it is with years old weekly use at the gym and carrying outside, yet she has stopped using it due to severe mold inside the rubber stopper. It's only been used for water. I've tried almost everything outside of bleach to no avail. It seems like the rubber is porous and allows mold to grow inside. I wanted to replace the stopper but come to find out you have to replace the entire cap. This seems like a waste. Especially if the issue comes from a poor material design in the first place.

reviews.author: Lasse
reviews.body:
We have 3 OTF bottles (out of 6 total Nalgene bottles)
2 of the OTF bottles have moldy lid seals even though they are washed frequently. Unfortunately you can’t buy a new seal and will therefore have to replace the entire lid. That is not very sustainable is it….

reviews.author: Cheryl
reviews.body:
Love the design except the silicone seal. Even run through the dishwasher regularly, it gets moldy! Yuck,! I end up relaxing the whole lid because I can't find just the silicone seal to purchase separately!
We've been using this style bottle for 13? Years. We've lost a few and had to replace lids but only 1 lid actually broke on all that time and all the bottoms are fine if not a bit scratched and scuffed. I love that I can put them in the dishwasher!

reviews.author: Smitha
reviews.body: I cannot keep this bloody thing closed. The metal bit can be really hard to snap into place, and without it, the top can’t stay closed on its own and drenches my stuff multiple times a day. This is an over-designed fail, rare and surprising considering Nalgene’s classic and successful simplicity. I’ll be replacing it with a screw-top lid.

listings.title: Narrow Mouth Cap
listings.description: Replacement closure. Fits all Narrow Mouth and Oasis bottles.

reviews.author: Patrick McMullin
reviews.body: I replaced the one that was originally on it for the palm one!{The Narrow cap fits perfectly on my Nalgene 32 oz. Water Bottle,and is groovy!}Surfs up dudes,and lassie's!

reviews.author: CJ Parker
reviews.body: My Nalgene 32 oz narrow mouth water bottle has been wonderful! I recent had the cap of my water bottle break, but I don't blame nalgene for that. I contacted warranty support and they got it replaced quickly! Highly recommend this product and company!

reviews.author: David Einreinhofer
reviews.body: The only reason I need to replace the lid for my small mouth Water bottle is cause i was a dope and it got damaged in the dishwasher. I have had this water bottle and 2 others for over 20 years. Best bottles I've ever owned.

reviews.author: Harrison Watts
reviews.body: The cap to my nalgene broke. This cap is not designed to lift the water bottle when full ( how mine broke ) I have only had this water bottle for half of a year and am sad that it's already damaged.

reviews.author: Joshua Stickley
reviews.body: It is an exact replacement part so of course it works perfectly. Installation was easy, just press the lid’s strap ring down working it around the flange on the bottle’s neck, and done! This part can be found on other websites for slightly cheaper if you are an extreme tight ass.

listings.title: 32oz Wide Mouth Ultralite Bottle
listings.description: Made from HDPE, a super light-weight material perfect for when you’re packing light.

reviews.author: Dianne Dalombe
reviews.body: These bottles are NOT made in the USA! Where are they made?!

reviews.author: Becca
reviews.body: Nalgene quality is good, but why do these bottles only measure 30 oz if they are supposed to hold 32?

reviews.author: Anno
reviews.body: Have been using these for backpacking since the 1960’s. Best because the softer plastic is less likely to crack if dropped on a rock. Plus my “kids” and I use (sturdy) stickers to tell them apart from each other on the trail. And they’ve lasted through several dishwasher loads.

reviews.author: Steve P
reviews.body: Simple and durable, love this water bottle! I like that it's dishwasher safe and can't beat the never-leak screw top. Gotta love affordable, high-quality products that last.

reviews.author: kurt maurer
reviews.body: In the 1980's I did a lot of rock climbing and used these bottles to cary my water for the day. In the summer I would freeze 2 and refrigerate 2 and cary them in insulated pouches (lived in Las Vegas, NV). I still have some of these 32oz. bottles and one 64oz. There great for the outdoors and have held up very well. These days I still use them for camping trips 30 years later.

listings.title: 32oz Neoprene Sleeve
listings.description: Nalgene’s classic neoprene sleeve. Fits snugly around 32-ounce bottle, making it easy to carry and sweat-free.

reviews.author: Blair L.
reviews.body: There is nothing else out there like this product! I freeze part of my Nalgene bottle with oral rehydration solution in it each night. This type sleeve prevents sweating which is important when I sit it on a table top. Too, it helps it to stay frozen longer.

reviews.author: Michael S
reviews.body: This is an excellent way to keep the condensation to a minimum while having a full bottle of cold water while sitting at a desk or just riding around in a car doing errands.

reviews.author: Cori
reviews.body: How do you clean/ wash this fabric?

listings.title: 10oz Flask
listings.description: Fits in pockets and lays flat. An all-in-one shot-glass, bottle and sharing vessel.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.body: I went through some of the complaints about what some call the "case" or "sleeve". This accessory is neither. The black removable cup, fits over the screw cap, should be a clue. This was designed as a container to carry alternative to water liquids (otherwise known as alcohol). One measures the alcohol out with the cap attachment (it holds one traditional jigger measurement), then pours it into the larger cup (some call it a sleeve or case). Then mixes it with Coke, Dr Pepper, water, etc. BEHOLD, a mixed alcohol beverage!

reviews.author: Tango Mike
reviews.body:
BEST Commuter/EDC bottle because of EZ slip sheath!
A lot of comments about the sheath/sharing cup not staying attached to the flask. For my application, carrying hydration in a crowded EDC or laptop bag, having the sharing cup stay in place in the bag for easy return of the tapered flask is a definite win that is not offered by any other manufacturer like those A5 designs. Jamming the oasis or cylinder bottles into a bag that has clothing or electronics in it is a PITA. I Just wish the flask came in 450/500 ml and 750 ml with the same lightweight design. I currently carry two in the meantime or maybe will try the oasis with a Natick stove or cup for the same effect but a heavier solution.

reviews.author: Beth
reviews.body:
I bought 2 and loved them, and have had many people question where they are from/where to get them (& was I drinking straight vodka from it 😂). Loved them until the cap detached from one and went missing 😔
It was in the side pouch of my bag, and I have never had this issue with any other bottle.
Unable to find a replacement cap.
I always had both bottles filled when out for the day, and can now only use one. Would recommend having the cap attached as other bottles have.

reviews.author: Marty W
reviews.body: This is the second time I purchased this flask. I really like it for its slim profile; it fits nicely inside a jacket pocket and isn't too noticeable. However, like a few others who have written reviews, the fact that the outer case does not fit snugly is an annoyance. I'll still give it 5 stars, but some simple redesign is warranted if Nalgene really feels the case to be necessary. I don't think it's necessary. I fixed the issue by placing a few self-stick felt pads on the inside of the case, close to the top edge. That seems to do the trick to keep the case on the flask itself.

reviews.author: Daily 3 mile Hiker
reviews.body: Just stick one in your pocket, go outside and have fun. This bulk-free bottle shape is absolutely the best.

listings.title: Travel Kit with Bag
listings.description: Contains leakproof bottles with color-coded caps, one cotton swab vial and one straight sided jar for pills or thicker gels and lotions. Includes (4) 2oz square bottles,  (1) 1oz jar, and (1) 1oz vial.

reviews.author: Rosa
reviews.body: I’ve had the Nalgene travel bag for 5 years plus. It’s roomy, practical, and has held up with weekly use. Please bring it bag without the containers!

reviews.author: Roxane
reviews.body: Love it! I've used this as my 311 bag for several trips, both foreign & domestic, and it has held up beautifully. Because it is subtly stretchy and has a flat bottom, you can fill it without it popping open as traditional ziplock bags do. Bring it back soon! I need to use them for gifts!!

listings.title: Medium Travel Kit
listings.description: Contains six guaranteed leakproof, durable bottles ranging from 1oz to 4oz; two storage jars and two handy dispensing caps. Jars are not recommended for liquid storage.

reviews.author: Xepe71
reviews.body: Good for oil, vinegar, salt, pepper, soap, and one spare for anything you might need (sugar, species?). Perfect size for hiking or eating at the office.

listings.title: 125 mL LDPE Bottle w/Dispensing cap
listings.description: Taking your own hair care products, lotions, baby oil, or body wash on a trip has never been more worry-free. Our Nalgene Flip-Top Leakproof Bottle is made with the same laboratory-quality seal used to package essential oils and toxic chemicals, and it’s guaranteed not to leak. The compact size makes it perfect for a travel kit, cosmetic bag, purse, backpack, or briefcase

reviews.author: Xke
reviews.body: Best bottle I have found for massage oil. Wider to height ratio helps to not tip over. Soft squeezable plastic is very nice. I have tried a lot of other types and brands, no one compares to the quality and function of this bottle. Highly recommend to others. Great product.

reviews.body: I love this unbranded bottle. Hope it comes back in stock

reviews.body:
This Polypropylene Nalgene Jar is unequalled anywhere 2118-0004
I have found them to be well made, robust and virtually indestructible
The lids provide a perfect seal and I have never had one leak or fail

reviews.author: pinellaspaul
reviews.body:
I have 8 of these. They are a wonderful product! very versatile, water tight, easy to clean! Love them! I want to buy MORE!!!
Please, please make MORE!!!

reviews.author: Jane Bottomley
reviews.body: These truly are the most useful amazing jars for storing soups or anything in the freezer or frig. You can write the contents on the lid with a Sharpie pen & easily wash it off to reuse for a different item. Cooking is my specialty and they are among my favorite product to use in the kitchen. I can't imagine life without them.

listings.description: Protect what you need to by storing in Nalgene leak-proof, air-tight storage containers. Stackable for convenient storage. The wide mouth opening makes it easy to scoop what you need when you need it. Shatter resistant and dishwasher safe. Shop our full range of storage .

reviews.author: Jesse Callahan Bryant
reviews.body: These are the best containers EVER. PERIOD. I've bought them for years but now they have been out of stock for a while? Please bring them back!!

reviews.author: Jillian
reviews.body: These are an old family favorite! My grandparents have been using these containers for years. I had to order new ones for them recently because they lost the cap in their old ones and luckily I ordered when I did, cause they've been out of stock since! I hope they come back in stock, I would like to get some more. These are the perfect size for travel.

listings.title: 32oz Storage Jar
listings.description: Protect what you need to by storing in Nalgene leak-proof, air-tight storage containers. Stackable for convenient storage. The wide mouth opening makes it easy to scoop what you need when you need it. Shatter resistant and dishwasher safe. Shop our full range of storage .

reviews.author: AstroBradbury
reviews.body: I have several of these that are over 20 years old! We use them for all types of dry storage in the kitchen. (coffee, grains, flour, etc...) The lids can chip when dropped but they have NEVER lost their seal. I just wish Nalgene would replacement lids.

reviews.author: Cindy H Krueger
reviews.body:
Have not yet tried the container...but I am trying to "green up" my plastic food storage items, so would REALLY like to be able to get some of these.. Can they be made in the USA??
Thank you!!

reviews.author: Paul Granger
reviews.body:
I have 5 of these. They are a wonderful product! very versatile, water tight, easy to clean! Love them! I want to buy MORE!!!
Please, make MORE!!!

reviews.author: Lee
reviews.body: Easy to clean. Very sturdy. Seals very nicely. Wish they would get more of these in stock.

listings.title: 64oz Growler
listings.description: Drink more water with Nalgene’s 64oz Growler. Made from super durable and lightweight Tritan Renew, our Growler comes in an easy to hold shape and is dishwasher-safe. The specially designed airtight cap keeps pressure in and leaks out. BPA/BPS free.

reviews.author: Jeffery Smith MD
reviews.body: Arrgh! You fail to give dimensions! I can’t tell if it will fit in small or RV refrigerator. Also inside diam of neck to see if it’s cleanable.

reviews.author: DWAYNE COMBS
reviews.body: I love these things so durable you can’t tear them up, the water taste awesome no aftertaste a customer for life.!

listings.title: 96oz Nalgene Cantene
listings.description: A camping classic that allows for easy storage when empty.

reviews.author: Joe
reviews.body: I've had mine years, take enough water from home for the whole day, freeze it 3/4 full and it keeps my lunch cool as well. leak free and warranty if it ever does

reviews.author: elflilstar
reviews.body: Great product! Put water in it and freeze for my cooler. When melted I add ice, often from the hotel ice machine) for my cooler. Folds up empty easy to pack. When the ice melts I have dog water or emergency water. Bought one about 10 years ago. It has been severely mistreated and hasn't leaked until now. Amazingly durable.

reviews.author: Paul Ingraham
reviews.body: Too expensive for a leaker to be later. Solve the leaking and I'll buy.

reviews.author: Mark Johnson
reviews.body: Leaks at the neck, as others have said. Nalgene used to make these to last years - no longer. Don't bother, hard pass.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.body: Great until it springs a leak. Which it does at the worst moment.

listings.title: 32oz Nalgene Cantene
listings.description: A camping classic that allows for easy storage when empty.

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.body:
I have had one of these Wide Mouth Canteens for years, and it has taken a beating. It is still going strong, albeit a little rugged. These are hard to find. I did find some on Ebay and bought all they had. Now that I'm going Ultralight, these are a lifesaver for the ability to fold them down as they get used. Also, I use one as my water bladder with a hose/spout attachment.
I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THESE!!!
I'm glad you have a few back in stock!!! I sent a link to my hiking buddies.
GET ONE! You know you need it!

reviews.author: Steve T
reviews.body:
Worked great for a few years unfortunately the seam exploded just after I got home from a trip yesterday. Thank goodness it wasn’t in my pack when it failed.
Are these guaranteed?

listings.description:
Summon your brew.

listings.title: Dark Spirits Klean Kanteen Bundle
listings.description:
A little coffee, a little chaos.
Complete with everything you need to dabble in the dark arts (minus the Ouija board), this limited-edition bundle was made for the bold souls who like their coffee strong and their supernatural encounters a little too real.
Just remember: some things are better left undisturbed—like you before you've had your first cup.

listings.title: Dark Spirits Long Sleeve
listings.description:

Strike a match, put on a pot of Pumpkin Chai and get ready for the room to smell like you just baked a homemade pie—because apparently setting something on fire is the appropriate way to celebrate sweater weather.

listings.description:

Featuring a Death Wish Coffee inspired meme on each, there's no easier way to let strangers know which one of you is fueled by coffee and which is powered by chaos.

listings.description:

May cause zoomies and heightened levels of excitement that could result in them keeping you up at night—we'll be ready with coffee.

listings.title: Hell Hound Mug
listings.description:
Guardian of the grind.
Legend has it a 3-headed hound with red eyes and a fiery temper guards the gates of the underworld and never sleeps. Perfect for anyone that can relate, this limited-edition, handcrafted mug is your loyal companion for the darkest hours—whether that's a 5 a.m. alarm or a 3 p.m. slump.
Made in collaboration with Deneen Pottery and best paired with coffee strong enough to wake the dead (or just the dead inside).

Spice up your décor.
Rather than wandering the aisles of your favorite home décor store looking for a needle in a haystack, get your fall decorating done in a flash with this limited-edition Pumpkin Spice Suncatcher.
Hang it where the sun hits just right, fill up your mug with Pumpkin Chai Coffee and take in the view—because when your fall décor is this easy, there's no reason to make a whole production out of it.

listings.title: Pumpkin To Talk About Tee
listings.description:
Squash the Basic Fall Fit.
If you're going to obsess over Fall regardless, you might as well commit to the bit. Inspired by our Pumpkin Chai Coffee and complete with a pumpkin flavor skull at the chest, this limited-edition tee is anything but basic.
Throw it on, pour a cup (or two) of your favorite brews and give 'em pumpkin to talk about.

listings.title: Pumpkin Chai Soda Can Candle
listings.description:
Wake up and smell the (pumpkin) coffee.
For those days when you've already had enough coffee to power a small city but still want your house to smell like a freshly brewed cup of Pumpkin Chai, this limited-edition candle delivers all the warm, seasonal scents of Fall of without keeping you up all hours of the night.
And because we're not about to make you clean pumpkin guts off your kitchen floor, it comes housed in a soda can glass perfect for adding to your collection or keeping on display long after the flame burns out.

listings.title: Espresso Roast, Cold Brew Coffee, Unsweetened
listings.description:
Too bold to be ignored.
For those who command attention, get loud with a cold brew that turns up the volume on intensity. Crafted from Certified Organic and Fair Trade arabica and robusta beans, we cold brew them for 18 hours. That means no chemicals. No concentrates. Just a bold brew that ensures the only thing bitter about your morning is that you have to go adult.
CAFFEINE CONTENT: This product contains approximately 250mg of caffeine based on a standard 6oz serving. Learn more about the caffeine content of all Death Wish Coffee products at deathwishcoffee.com/caffeine .

listings.title: Bodum Portable French Press
listings.description:
There's more to life than sipping coffee on the couch.
Whether you’re chasing dramatic mountain views or escaping the daily grind (literally), this portable French press is ready to keep up.
Made with durable stainless steel and double-wall insulation, the built-in press lets you brew fresh coffee wherever you are, while the rugged design means it can handle the bumps, drops, and adventures that come with living life at full speed.
Pack it for the campsite, bring it to the office, or keep it close for those moments when you realize your day requires significantly more caffeine than originally…

listings.title: Caffeine Catalyst LED Dry Erase Board
listings.description:
Warning: May cause dangerously productive behavior.
That little list of “things to do someday”? Consider it done.
This limited-edition LED Whiteboard was built for big ideas, wild plans, and those moments when coffee hits so hard your brain starts creating more work for itself.
Whether you’re mapping out your next big move or writing down the 25 things you somehow decided to accomplish before noon, this glowing command center keeps your chaos organized.
Erase it. Rewrite it. Repeat until your ambition runs out (spoiler: it won’t).

listings.title: Coffee Consultation Tumbler
listings.description:
What's cheaper than therapy? Coffee.
Made for keeping your iced coffee cold through unsolicited opinions, pointless meetings, and group chats that can't take a hint, this limited-edition tumbler says everything you can't.
Fill it up, sip responsibly, and let your coffee handle the difficult conversations.

listings.title: Human Body Tumbler
listings.description:
The math is mathing.
It doesn't take an anatomy wizard—or a coffee expert for that matter—to recognize the full potential of the human body.
Proudly displaying the kind of questionable science that somehow makes perfect sense before your first cup, this limited-edition tumbler is the perfect way to keep your favorite brews—and inner dialogue—on ice.

listings.title: Sidekick Cocktail Shaker
listings.description:
Shake things up.
In-laws driving you crazy? Say less.
Ideal for crafting up caffeinated cocktails and relieving holiday stress, this limited edition cocktail shaker is meant to be your new partner in crime whether you're shaking things up or stirring the pot.
